items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: I played one job with Chris Kelly.

ctx.x: But you'd still keep playing short numbers. Oh yeah. About, what did you say, about two or four choruses?
About three or four choruses, yeah. Did you ever play with Chris? Everybody would pick their best numbers for advertising. Pick four or five numbers and just play that all the while they advertise.
Over and over again and he's called about the same ones. I started to ask if you ever played with Chris Kelly.

items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: I played one job with Chris Kelly.

ctx.x: You ever played with Louis Dumaine? No. I never played with Louis.

What about Chris Kelly? Chris Kelly? I played one job with Chris Kelly. I don't remember where it was. All I remember is that I played one job with him. And Rene? You ever played with Rene? No, I never played with Rene. I never played with Rene. Well, I guess in those times you played one job with one band. You still am sometimes, huh?

Yeah. How did the Thomas band in the old days compare with the band he's got now? Was it pretty much the same? Yeah. Has he changed any in the way he plays? No, I don't see. No, I don't see. No, I don't see. No, I don't see. No, I don't see.
